decision: Use the sequencer built into your data tool at low volume. Once cold email is a main channel, move sending to Instantly or Smartlead with several warmed inboxes on separate domains. Cold email carries legal duties that differ by region.
details: Second alt added: lemlist (Email USD 55/user/mo annual, Multichannel USD 87 annual; 14-day trial).

region_notes.EU: B2B cold email needs a lawful basis and easy opt-out; rules vary by country.
region_notes.UK: PECR: corporate subscribers may be emailed with opt-out.
region_notes.US: CAN-SPAM: no consent needed but opt-out, address and honest headers are mandatory.
region_notes.India: No dedicated cold-email statute; DPDP applies from 2027.
